description: Find creators with a live Piku page by niche words (matched against the niches they chose, then their bio and Rates), location (their city and country, then their bio), platform and starting price. Prices are starting prices in the creator's currency; max_from_price is compared after converting currencies. Creators who share prices on request are left out when max_from_price is set. Results are paged: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

location.description: A city, a country name or code, or both, like Accra, Ghana

niche.description: Words like skincare, travel, code reviews

name: search_creators
title: Search creators
